text:
maria: quick ping — can someone take a look at PR #6341? CI keeps failing on checkout_e2e::payment_flow and it's blocking the release train. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/6341

chris: I can take a quick look. Is this consistently failing or flaky?

maria: flaky — happens ~1/5 runs. logs attached below when I retried locally. noticing a timing issue in the final confirmation step.

sam: dropping the failing snippet here, looks like a race on the payment service mock: 
```
Error: Expected element "#payment-confirm" to be visible
at checkout_e2e/payment_flow.spec.js:142:21
TimeoutError: waiting for selector "#payment-confirm" failed: timeout 30000ms
```

lee: ok that matches a flake we've seen elsewhere after the network mock change. two quick options: add a small extra wait in the test, or mark it flaky and add a retry hook. pref for retry + ticket to investigate root cause.

ashley: +1 for retry for now. we shouldn't block the merge. if you add `test.retries(2)` and a short note in the PR description I'm fine approving.

maria: thanks — added `test.retries(2)` and a brief note. also added a TODO ticket: T-4927 to root cause. updated PR. could someone re-run CI when it's ready? @chris? :pray:

chris: will do in a few mins. triggering a rerun now: `./scripts/ci/rerun_job.sh 6341 checkout_e2e`

dev-bot: CI: Rerun queued by chris for PR #6341 (job: checkout_e2e). Job id: 23218.

dev-bot: CI: Job 23218 started.

maria: thanks all. if the rerun passes can we get a quick approval from @ashley or @lee? I'll squash the fix and merge.

lee: I reviewed the diff — small and documented. giving a +1, but prefer we monitor metrics post-merge for 24h.

dev-bot: CI: Job 23218 succeeded. artifacts: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/artifacts/23218

ashley: approved. merging now. please follow up on T-4927 for the long-term fix. :thumbsup:

maria: merged and backfilled the ticket. thanks everyone!
